title: Live H1 Owner Bridge
objective: Implement or precisely specify a live-owner bridge from resident generated h1 candidate owners toward the final root without JSON or fixture joins

handoff.summary: Implemented one source-transparent native live-owner edge from the resident h=1 candidate through unit-lattice preparation, pre-getfu factor/provenance composition, and equal-bound cleanarch final-driver status. The bridge consumes no unit/final fixture or PARI oracle and agrees in CPython, JavaScript, GMP, and tagged execution.
risks: The focused checker currently reads the qualified resident JSON only to stand in for the live owners; the native function itself performs no serialization.
Exact eager unit reconstruction still needs the legitimate high-precision embedding/log rebuild and is explicitly not claimed.
next_steps: Call pari_live_h1_owner_bridge directly at the bottom of the shared resident root using its already allocated owners.
Connect a source-transparent precision rebuild to signed cubic getfu, then use resident-derived factor materialization for the internal final publication.
